description: Trade with traders: contacts in the sky, what each buys and sells, and buying or selling with the landed trader. buy and sell report until confirm: true.

options.id: inventory: One contact; left out, every contact. buy, sell: The trader contact. Any what that takes an id takes a list: one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, payload | error}], count, success_count, error_count}, payload the one-id reply; a bad id is a row with error.
options.card: inventory: The card whose holder's goods count; default the player's. buy: The credit card; default the one the player carries. sell: The credit card paid into; default the one the player carries.
options.items: buy: Up to 32 lines {name or prefab, quantity}, in order. sell: Up to 32 lines {name or prefab, quantity}.
options.confirm: true acts; left out, it reports.
